alerts.title: Iran war live: Houthis control Red Sea coast, Saudi pipeline shut down
alerts.why: Houthi control of Red Sea and Saudi pipeline shutdown threaten major crude supply chokepoints and drive safe-haven demand.

itemsSent.title: Consumer outlook plunges in September as inflation outlook worsens
itemsSent.why: Falling consumer confidence and worsening inflation fears raise stagflation concerns, slightly boosting safe-haven gold while signaling weaker demand for crude oil.

itemsSent.title: Houthis seek to reassure shipping after Mokha seizure, but analysts warn Saudi-linked vessels remain at risk
itemsSent.why: Ongoing Red Sea risks are largely priced in; continued selective targeting of Saudi-linked vessels maintains existing geopolitical risk premium without escalating supply disruptions.

itemsSent.title: Suez Canal recovery gathers pace as Hormuz disruption boosts traffic, but Bab el Mandeb revival stalls
itemsSent.why: Increased tanker traffic and Suez recovery indicate smoother crude flows despite Middle East chokepoint disruptions, weighing slightly on oil.

itemsSent.title: Houthis declare Red Sea shipping safe except for Saudi vessels
itemsSent.why: Houthi assurance of Red Sea safety, excluding Saudi ships, eases supply chain disruption fears, reducing risk premiums for crude oil.

itemsSent.title: India’s crude oil imports spike 13% on year in Jul-26
itemsSent.why: India's crude imports spiked 13% year-on-year in July with strong refinery runs, signaling robust physical demand supporting crude prices.

itemsSent.title: US cuts off bunkering and repair for ships in Iranian trade
itemsSent.why: US tightening sanctions on Iranian trade adds geopolitical risk premium to crude, while gold remains largely unaffected by maritime service restrictions.

itemsSent.title: Rising petrol costs drive sharp inflation increase in US in August
itemsSent.why: Rising US petrol prices lift headline inflation, dampening rate cut hopes for gold while showing stronger domestic fuel demand for oil.

itemsSent.title: Oil extends rally on further Middle East disruptions
itemsSent.why: Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries cut crude processing, supporting crude prices and driving record diesel highs.

itemsSent.title: U.S.-Facilitated Hormuz Transits Help Lift Gulf Crude Exports Above 10 Million Bpd
itemsSent.why: US-facilitated transits through the Strait of Hormuz help lift Gulf crude exports, easing supply concerns and weighing on oil prices.

itemsSent.title: ‘China Buffer’ stabilizes world economy amid tensions, crisis
itemsSent.why: China reducing oil imports eases global supply pressures, acting as a slight bearish factor for crude prices.

itemsSent.title: APPEC: Tankers transit Hormuz in the dark as oil flows persist
itemsSent.why: Strait of Hormuz security risks and AIS blackouts increase geopolitical risk premiums for crude oil flows.

itemsSent.title: Poten: VLCC Rates Hit Unprecedented Levels Amidst Mideast Conflict
itemsSent.why: Rising VLCC tanker rates driven by Middle East conflict increase shipping costs, supporting crude and safe-haven gold prices near term.

itemsSent.title: Why VLCC rates just went ballistic and how they could go even higher
itemsSent.why: Surging VLCC freight rates indicate strong crude transport demand and tighter tanker availability, slightly supporting physical oil market sentiment.
